column1: # Licence and copyright notice of every npm package in pnpm-lock.yaml.
# Read from each package's own package.json and the LICENSE inside its
# tarball, both in the Bazel cache (rules_js extracts package.json and
# keeps package.tgz), falling back to registry.npmjs.org.
# The web UI is part of what Cadpole ships -- //src/web:dist is embedded in
# the CLI binary and served by `cadpole serve` -- so an npm package's licence
# is exactly as binding as a crate's, and is checked against the same
